passive.name: Dirty Fighting
passive.description: Every three hits from Akshan's Attacks and Abilities deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion. When Akshan Attacks, he fires an additional Attack for reduced damage. If he cancels the additional Attack, he instead gains Move Speed.

spells.name: Avengerang
spells.description: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals physical damage, extending the range each time an enemy is hit. Champion hits grant Akshan Move Speed decaying over second.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation FinalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Going Rogue
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Heroic Swing
spells.description: First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit. Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for physical damage per shot. Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot. Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early. Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamageToDeal was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Comeuppance
spells.description: Akshan locks onto a champion and begins overcharging his gun for up to seconds, storing up to bullets. Recast: Akshan unleashes the stored bullets, each dealing at least physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to physical damage based on missing Health.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamagePerBulletWithCrit was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
